title: Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of a New Refractory Equiatomic CrHfNbTaTi High-Entropy Alloy (as-cast)
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting in a high-purity Ar atmosphere using commercially obtained raw materials (purity > 99.9 wt.%) on a water-cooled copper crucible with titanium-gettered oxygen. Repeated melting was performed four times with electromagnetic stirring and inversion to improve homogeneity.

title: Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of a New Refractory Equiatomic CrHfNbTaTi High-Entropy Alloy (homogenized)
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting followed by homogenization annealing at 1273 K for 20 h under vacuum. Samples were wrapped with 0.1-mm Ta foil to prevent oxidation.
